ov: Twenty species of large, long-legged, long-necked wading birds with stout bills. They soar on rising warm air to save energy, and many migrate long distances. Clattering their bills is an important way of communicating at the nest.
rg: Nearly worldwide, but not the poles, most of North America or much of Australia. Richest in species in tropical Asia and sub-Saharan Africa.
df: Frogs, fish, insects, earthworms, small birds and small mammals.
fx: The marabou stork’s 3.2 m wingspan is among the widest of any land bird.
Some stork nests grow over 2 m across and are used for many years.
